decisions.reason: Selecting a 2.5-quart bowl does not change the existing requirement for high-quality mixing and consistent foam.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the necessary 2.5-quart bowl compatibility and smaller, thinner whisk configuration; no correction is required.
The exact bowl capacity does not alter the independently established requirement that bowls be easy to remove and swap quickly.
The source specifies bowl and whisk sizing but does not change the splash-control target.
Changing the bowl capacity to 2.5 quarts does not modify the existing leak-prevention requirements.
The bowl-capacity decision has no effect on the beige and green color scheme.
The source does not change the valve mechanism, closed-valve behavior, or controlled-flow requirement.
The 2.5-quart bowl capacity does not alter the established spout cleaning or sanitation requirements.
